name: Dubai Holding
tagline: A diversified global investment company and holding company for seven operating businesses: Real Estate, Land Estates, Asset Management, Hospitality, Entertainment, Community Management and Investments. The figures below are public and cited; the vertical operating models in this app are illustrative.

source.title: Dubai Holding
source.quote: With over AED500 billion in assets across 30+ countries and 10 sectors, our investments fuel economic growth, elevate quality of life and drive sustainability.

source.title: Gulf News
source.quote: it contributed 13.5 per cent to Dubai's gross domestic product (GDP) in 2025

source.title: Dubai Holding
source.quote: AED 500bn total assets 45K+ combined workforce 30+ countries

overview.label: People living, working & playing in its communities

source.title: Dubai Holding Impact Report
source.quote: Managing and building communities where 1.3m people live, work and play

overview.label: Unique visitors to its destinations a year

source.title: Dubai Holding Impact Report
source.quote: welcoming more than 11 million unique visitors across our destinations each year.

pillars: Partnering with global institutions to support FDI

A commercial mindset in every decision

valueCreation.text: Group strategy and value creation sits with the Group CIO: leading strategy planning and development and executing Group-wide value creation initiatives and strategic projects.

source.title: Dubai Holding: Leadership
source.quote: Omar is also responsible for the Group's strategy and value creation mandate, a role which involves leading the Group's strategy planning and development as well as the execution of Group-wide value creation initiatives and strategic projects.

realEstate.companies: Dubai Holding Real Estate (Nakheel · Meraas · Dubai Properties) & Land Estates
realEstate.fact: Oversees the largest land portfolio in Dubai, incl. Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Islands

source.title: Dubai Holding: Our companies
source.quote: Overseeing the largest land portfolio in Dubai, shaping and developing iconic master plans such as Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Islands.

source.title: Dubai Holding Hospitality
source.quote: Dubai Holding Hospitality owns a portfolio of 36 hotels, partnering with leading hospitality brands to enhance performance and grow long-term value.

leisure.companies: Dubai Holding Entertainment (Global Village · Dubai Parks and Resorts · Coca-Cola Arena · ARN)
leisure.fact: Destinations including Global Village, Dubai Parks and Resorts and the 17,000-capacity Coca-Cola Arena

retail.companies: Dubai Holding Asset Management (Dubai Retail · Dubai Residential REIT · TECOM)
retail.fact: Dubai Retail spans 58+ malls, lifestyle destinations and retail centres

source.title: Dubai Holding Asset Management
source.quote: Dubai Retail manages one of Dubai's most extensive retail and leisure portfolios, spanning more than 58 malls, lifestyle destinations and retail centres.

community.fact: Runs communities developed by Nakheel, Meraas and Dubai Properties

source.title: Dubai Holding Community Management
source.quote: the organisation oversees the everyday operations and long-term vitality of some of the city's most iconic residential destinations, including those developed by Nakheel, Meraas and Dubai Properties.

urbanServices.companies: Integrated urban services (FM, security, technical services)
urbanServices.fact: Modelled as an operating pillar; no separate public financials

moves.title: Nakheel and Meydan incorporated into Dubai Holding
moves.detail: Directive to create a more financially efficient entity aligned with the Dubai Economic Agenda D33; the boards of both companies were abolished.

source.title: Dubai Media Office
source.quote: The goal is to create a more financially efficient entity, owning assets worth hundreds of billions

moves.title: Palm Jebel Ali: AED 5bn+ of villa contracts awarded
moves.detail: Seven islands, 16 fronds and 90+ km of beachfront; villas on the first six fronds due by late 2026.

source.title: Dubai Holding
source.quote: Three major contracts were awarded in October, collectively valued at more than AED 5 billion, for the construction of exclusive ultra-luxury villas on the first six fronds of Palm Jebel Ali

moves.title: Dubai Residential REIT IPO on DFM
moves.detail: The GCC's largest listed REIT. The preset reproduces the deal: FY2025 NOI of ~AED 1.49bn, a 15% float at the AED 14.3bn listing value, raising ~AED 2.1bn. Redeploying at a 12% yield on cost is our assumption: below the 10.4% listing yield, recycling would destroy value.

source.title: Zawya
source.quote: The Offering raised AED 2,145 million (USD 584 million), with Dubai Residential REIT listing at a market capitalisation of AED 14.3 billion (USD 3.9 billion), firmly positioning it as the largest listed REIT in the GCC.

moves.title: First strategic land sale to a third-party developer at Palm Jebel Ali (Select Group)
moves.detail: Monetising the land bank through a partner developer at Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Design District.

source.title: Dubai Holding
source.quote: The milestone agreement marks Dubai Holding's first strategic land sale with a third-party developer at Palm Jebel Ali

moves.title: Acquires Jumeirah Mallorca
moves.detail: Takes the owned hospitality portfolio to 34 hotels, including five Jumeirah hotels in Europe.

source.title: Dubai Holding
source.quote: Dubai Holding Hospitality's latest acquisition in Mallorca expands its ownership portfolio to 34 hotels and resorts, including five Jumeirah hotels across Europe.

moves.title: Dubai Residential REIT FY2025: revenue AED 1.95bn, 98.3% occupancy
moves.detail: Adjusted EBITDA AED 1.49bn (76.4% margin); GAV AED 23.5bn.

source.title: Dubai Media Office
source.quote: Dubai Residential REIT delivered revenue of AED 1.95 billion in 2025, representing a 9.0% increase year-on-year

moves.title: Aldar JV expanded with AED 38bn of new developments
moves.detail: Two land plots delivering almost 14,000 homes. The preset models 100% of the JV's GDV; Dubai Holding's share is not disclosed.

source.title: Dubai Holding
source.quote: adding two strategic land plots in Dubai that will deliver almost 14,000 new homes with a combined gross development value (GDV) exceeding AED 38 billion.

moves.title: Divests 24% of Empower to DEWA for AED 5.18bn
moves.detail: Capital recycling out of a non-core utility stake.

source.title: Dubai Holding
source.quote: DEWA's stake in Empower from 56% to 80% (additional of 24% from the current ownership) for an amount of AED 5.184 billion.

moves.title: Becomes Emaar's largest shareholder (29.73%)
moves.detail: Acquires ICD's 22.27% stake, consolidating Dubai's real-estate champions under one shareholder.

source.title: Dubai Holding
source.quote: Following completion of the transaction, Dubai Holding's total shareholding in Emaar Properties has increased to 29.73%

moves.title: Group-wide enterprise AI deployment with Microsoft
moves.detail: Technology transformation alongside the Aither JV with Palantir.

moves.title: Skylight Mall announced: 1.3m sq ft GLA, 360+ stores, opening 2027
moves.detail: A super-regional mall from Dubai Retail.

moves.title: Palm Springs phase 1 sells out: 977 homes, AED 5.5bn
moves.detail: Family-home master community launch. The preset reproduces the release.

source.title: Dubai Holding
source.quote: all 977 homes in the initial release sold, representing a total sales value of AED5.5 billion.
